title: IncuBrix CreatorOps Platform Launch

copy.headline: Crea contenido sin límites
copy.support: Descubre ideas, produce en audio y video, y publica en todas partes.

concept: Un bucle elegante y tecnológico que representa el flujo continuo de la creación de contenido, desde la idea inicial hasta la distribución multicanal con IA.

design_system.style: Modern vector illustration with rich layered gradients, glowing nodes, and clean geometric shapes.
design_system.lighting: Top-left warm sunlight illuminating a deep midnight background with soft rim lights.

composition.hero: A central glowing hub-and-orbit ring system rendered in 3D-style vector layers. A large central golden sphere emitting subtle cyan rays, surrounded by three orbiting nodes representing text, audio and video production.
props: Small glowing triangles drifting on the right
Light dust motes scattered across the center
composition.background: Deep radial gradient from dark navy to midnight black with a warm amber glow directly behind the hero.
decor: Abstract diagonal vector waves in the lower section
